items.sub: Is the path to the target open?

slides.label: 01 · LEVEL
slides.title: Trade from a *level.*
slides.body: Previous day high and low. Weekly and daily fair value gaps. Then 4H, 1H and 15M gaps.

slides.label: 02 · WALL
slides.title: Protect the *stop.*
slides.body: Stop at the high or low of the structure, inside a 15-minute or higher gap. That gap is the wall.

slides.label: 03 · ROAD
slides.title: Keep the road *open.*
slides.body: Stacked liquidity, failure swings, equal highs and lows. Target the nearest one, not the full draw.

slides.title: Two walls.
slides.lead: High resistance on both sides is a coin flip. Skipping is part of the model.
